coordinateSystem.name: atlas-schematic
coordinateSystem.notice: Map positions are schematic reconstructions, not surveyed locations. The scale varies by region; map distances are estimates, not measured road lengths.

calendar.notice: absoluteYear = year + age offset; a sorting convention, not Gregorian time. YT does not imply solar-year duration.

records.title: Durin the Deathless awakes
records.description: Durin, eldest of the Seven Fathers of the Dwarves, wakes beneath Mount Gundabad, ever after a holy place to his people. He wanders south to Azanulbizar and sees the crown of stars in Mirrormere.

records.title: Khazad-dûm founded
records.description: Durin founds the mansions of Khazad-dûm beneath the Misty Mountains above Mirrormere. It becomes the greatest of all Dwarf-kingdoms.

records.title: The Nandor turn aside at the Misty Mountains
records.description: On the Great Journey westward, Lenwë's people refuse to cross the Hithaeglir and settle in the Vales of Anduin; from them come the Silvan Elves of Lórien and Greenwood.

records.title: Dwarves of Nogrod and Belegost
records.description: The Dwarf-cities of Nogrod and Belegost flourish in the Blue Mountains and trade with the Elves of Beleriand throughout the First Age.

records.title: War of Wrath begins
records.description: The host of the Valar comes against Morgoth. In the cataclysm that follows, Beleriand is drowned and only Lindon, east of the Blue Mountains, remains; Nogrod and Belegost are ruined.

records.title: Morgoth overthrown; end of the First Age
records.description: Morgoth is cast into the Void. Gil-galad gathers the remaining Eldar in Lindon, the last remnant of Ossiriand.

records.title: Foundation of Lindon and the Grey Havens
records.description: Gil-galad establishes the realm of Lindon around the Gulf of Lune; Círdan builds the havens of Mithlond, whence the Elves may sail to the West.

records.title: Dwarves of the Blue Mountains come to Khazad-dûm
records.description: Many Dwarves of ruined Belegost and Nogrod migrate east to Khazad-dûm, swelling its wealth and power.

records.title: First Númenórean ship reaches Middle-earth
records.description: Vëantur captains the first ship of Númenor back to Middle-earth, landing at the Grey Havens; Men of the West begin to visit the coasts.

records.title: Eregion founded
records.description: Noldor led by Galadriel and Celeborn, and later Celebrimbor, found the realm of Eregion (Hollin) near the West-gate of Moria, in friendship with the Dwarves.

records.title: Vinyalondë (Lond Daer) established
records.description: Aldarion the Mariner builds the haven of Vinyalondë at the mouth of the Gwathló, the first Númenórean foothold in Middle-earth; it later grows into Lond Daer.

records.title: Sauron begins Barad-dûr
records.description: Alarmed by the Númenóreans, Sauron chooses Mordor as his stronghold and begins the building of the Dark Tower.

records.title: Annatar comes to Eregion
records.description: Sauron, disguised as Annatar 'Lord of Gifts', is rejected by Gil-galad in Lindon but welcomed by Celebrimbor's smiths in Eregion.

records.title: The Rings of Power are forged
records.description: Under Annatar's guidance the Gwaith-i-Mírdain begin forging the Rings of Power; the Seven and the Nine are made in these years.

records.title: The Three Rings completed
records.description: Celebrimbor alone forges Vilya, Nenya and Narya, the Three Rings of the Elves, untouched by Sauron's hand.

records.title: The One Ring forged
records.description: Sauron forges the One Ring in the fires of Orodruin and completes Barad-dûr; the Elves perceive him and hide the Three.

records.title: Sauron invades Eriador
records.description: The War of the Elves and Sauron: Sauron's armies pour into Eriador; Elrond is sent from Lindon with a force to aid Eregion.

records.title: Sack of Eregion
records.description: Eregion is laid waste and Celebrimbor slain; the Gates of Moria are shut. Sauron takes the Nine and the Seven, but not the Three.

records.title: Rivendell founded
records.description: Elrond, retreating north with the survivors of Eregion, founds the refuge of Imladris in a hidden valley beneath the Misty Mountains.

records.title: Battle of the Gwathló
records.description: A great navy sent by Tar-Minastir of Númenor lands at Lindon and Vinyalondë; Sauron is defeated at the Gwathló and driven from Eriador.

records.title: Númenórean dominions on the coasts
records.description: The Númenóreans establish permanent havens and dominions along the coasts of Middle-earth; the forests of Minhiriath and Enedwaith are felled for their ships.

records.title: The Nazgûl first appear
records.description: The Ringwraiths, Sauron's Nine slaves of the Nine Rings, first appear in Middle-earth.

records.title: Umbar fortified
records.description: The great natural harbour of Umbar is made into a mighty fortress of Númenor, later the stronghold of the King's Men.

records.title: Pelargir built
records.description: The haven of Pelargir is built on the Anduin and becomes the chief harbour of the Faithful Númenóreans.

records.title: Ar-Pharazôn lands at Umbar
records.description: Ar-Pharazôn the Golden lands with a vast armament at Umbar; Sauron humbles himself and is taken to Númenor as a prisoner (S.A. 3262).

records.title: Downfall of Númenor
records.description: Númenor is destroyed; Elendil and his sons escape in nine ships and are cast upon the shores of Middle-earth.

records.title: Arnor founded
records.description: Elendil founds the North-kingdom of Arnor, with his capital at Annúminas on Lake Evendim, and holds the palantíri of the North.

records.title: Gondor founded
records.description: Isildur and Anárion found the South-kingdom of Gondor; Osgiliath is their capital, with Minas Ithil and Minas Anor on either hand.

records.title: Sauron takes Minas Ithil
records.description: Sauron attacks Gondor, seizes Minas Ithil and burns the White Tree; Isildur flees down Anduin to Elendil while Anárion holds Osgiliath.

records.title: Last Alliance of Elves and Men
records.description: Gil-galad and Elendil form the Last Alliance; in S.A. 3431 their host musters at Imladris.

records.title: Battle of Dagorlad
records.description: The host of the Last Alliance crosses the Misty Mountains and defeats Sauron's armies on the Battle Plain before the Morannon.

records.title: Siege of Barad-dûr begins
records.description: The Alliance lays siege to the Dark Tower for seven years; Anárion is slain in S.A. 3440.

records.title: Sauron overthrown; Isildur takes the Ring
records.description: Gil-galad and Elendil perish overthrowing Sauron; Isildur cuts the Ring from his hand with the hilt-shard of Narsil but refuses to destroy it. End of the Second Age.

records.title: Disaster of the Gladden Fields
records.description: Isildur and his three eldest sons are slain by Orcs; the One Ring slips from his finger in the Anduin and is lost.

records.title: Shards of Narsil brought to Rivendell
records.description: Ohtar, Isildur's esquire, brings the shards of Narsil to Imladris, where Valandil, Isildur's heir, is kept.

records.title: Minas Anor rebuilt
records.description: King Ostoher rebuilds Minas Anor, where the Kings of Gondor thereafter dwell in summer.

records.title: Rómendacil I defeats the Easterlings
records.description: Tarostar drives back the first invasion of Easterlings and takes the name Rómendacil, 'East-victor'; he is slain in a later battle in T.A. 541.

records.title: The Ship-kings of Gondor
records.description: Tarannon Falastur, first of the Ship-kings, extends Gondor's power along the coasts west and south of the Mouths of Anduin.

records.title: Division of Arnor
records.description: On the death of Eärendur, Arnor is divided among his sons into Arthedain, Cardolan and Rhudaur; Fornost becomes the seat of Arthedain.

records.title: Eärnil I takes Umbar
records.description: Eärnil I captures Umbar by land and sea and makes it a great fortress of Gondor; he is lost at sea three years later.

records.title: The Istari arrive
records.description: The five Wizards, emissaries of the Valar, land at the Grey Havens; Círdan gives Narya to Gandalf.

records.title: Hyarmendacil I conquers Harad
records.description: Ciryaher defeats the Haradrim and takes the name Hyarmendacil 'South-victor'; Gondor reaches the height of its power.

records.title: Greenwood the Great becomes Mirkwood
records.description: A shadow falls upon the forest as Sauron, in secret, makes his stronghold at Amon Lanc; Men begin to call it Mirkwood.

records.title: Harfoots enter Eriador
records.description: The Harfoots, first of the Hobbit-kinds to cross the Misty Mountains, come into Eriador; the Fallohides and Stoors follow c. T.A. 1150.

records.title: The Wise discover Dol Guldur
records.description: The Wise learn that an evil power has made a stronghold at Dol Guldur, and suppose it to be one of the Nazgûl.

records.title: Stoors cross the Redhorn Pass
records.description: The Stoors come over the Redhorn Pass and settle in the Angle and in Dunland; the Fallohides enter Eriador by way of Rivendell.

records.title: Rómendacil II defeats the Easterlings
records.description: Minalcar destroys the Easterlings beyond the Sea of Rhûn, takes the name Rómendacil, and afterwards raises the Argonath at the northern border of Gondor.

records.title: The Argonath raised
records.description: Rómendacil II builds the Pillars of the Kings, giant likenesses of Isildur and Anárion, to mark Gondor's northern bound on Anduin.

records.title: The Witch-king founds Angmar
records.description: The Nazgûl reappear; their chief establishes the realm of Angmar in the north with its capital at Carn Dûm, to destroy the Dúnedain of Arnor.

records.title: Hobbits settle in Bree
records.description: Hobbits move westward from the Angle, fleeing the troubles of Rhudaur and Angmar, and some settle at Bree.

records.title: Argeleb I slain fighting Rhudaur
records.description: King Argeleb I of Arthedain is slain in battle against Rhudaur, now secretly allied with Angmar, on the Weather Hills.

records.title: Fall of the Tower of Amon Sûl
records.description: The Witch-king invades Arnor: the tower of Amon Sûl is burned and razed, Rhudaur occupied and Cardolan ravaged; Arveleg I is slain.

records.title: The Kin-strife begins
records.description: Civil war breaks out in Gondor over the succession of Eldacar, whose mother was a Northman; in 1437 Osgiliath is burned and the palantír lost.

records.title: Battle of the Crossings of Erui
records.description: Eldacar returns from Rhovanion and slays the usurper Castamir at the Crossings of Erui; Castamir's sons hold Pelargir under siege before fleeing to Umbar.

records.title: Rebels seize Umbar
records.description: The defeated followers of Castamir take Umbar and make it a refuge of Gondor's enemies: the Corsairs of Umbar.

records.title: Founding of the Shire
records.description: Marcho and Blanco lead hobbits across the Bridge of Stonebows with leave of King Argeleb II; the Shire Reckoning begins.

records.title: Corsairs slay King Minardil at Pelargir
records.description: The Corsairs of Umbar ravage Pelargir and slay Minardil, King of Gondor.

records.title: The Great Plague
records.description: The Plague sweeps from Rhovanion into Gondor: King Telemnar and his children die, the White Tree withers and Osgiliath is largely deserted. It reaches the Shire in 1637.

records.title: Barrow-wights enter the Barrow-downs
records.description: The last Dúnedain of Cardolan perish in the Plague; evil spirits out of Angmar and Rhudaur enter the deserted mounds of Tyrn Gorthad.

records.title: The King's seat moved to Minas Anor
records.description: Tarondor moves the King's house from Osgiliath to Minas Anor and plants a seedling of the White Tree; the watch on Mordor is abandoned.

records.title: Umbar retaken
records.description: King Telumehtar storms Umbar, drives out the Corsairs and takes the name Umbardacil.

records.title: Battle of the Plains
records.description: The Wainriders defeat Gondor and the Northmen; King Narmacil II is slain and Gondor's eastern territories lost. Marhwini leads the Northmen who become the Éothéod to the Vales of Anduin.

records.title: Calimehtar defeats the Wainriders
records.description: King Calimehtar wins a great victory over the Wainriders on Dagorlad, aided by a revolt of the Northmen in Rhovanion.

records.title: Battle of the Camp
records.description: King Ondoher and his sons fall before the Morannon; Eärnil, captain of the Southern Army, destroys the Wainriders at the Battle of the Camp and becomes king (1945).

records.title: Fall of Fornost
records.description: The Witch-king overruns Arthedain and takes Fornost; King Arvedui flees to the Lossoth of Forochel. End of the North-kingdom.

records.title: Arvedui drowns in the Icebay of Forochel
records.description: Círdan's ship sent to rescue Arvedui founders in the ice; the last King of Arthedain and the palantíri of Annúminas and Amon Sûl are lost.

records.title: Battle of Fornost
records.description: Eärnur's host from Gondor, with Círdan and Glorfindel, destroys the army of Angmar; the Witch-king flees. Glorfindel foretells that 'not by the hand of man will he fall'.

records.title: Angmar destroyed
records.description: The realm of Angmar west of the Mountains is ended; its capital Carn Dûm is emptied.

records.title: Frumgar leads the Éothéod north
records.description: The Éothéod migrate to the lands between the Grey Mountains and the sources of Anduin, driving out the remnant of Angmar's folk.

records.title: Bucca of the Marish, first Thain
records.description: With no king in the North, the hobbits choose Bucca of the Marish as the first Thain of the Shire.

records.title: Durin's Bane awakes
records.description: Delving for mithril, the Dwarves release a Balrog of Morgoth beneath Caradhras; Durin VI is slain, and Náin I the next year.

records.title: The Dwarves flee Moria
records.description: Durin's folk abandon Khazad-dûm. Fear drives many Silvan Elves from Lórien; Amroth and Nimrodel are lost.

records.title: Amroth lost at sea
records.description: Waiting for Nimrodel at the haven of Edhellond, King Amroth of Lórien leaps from his ship in a storm and is drowned in the Bay of Belfalas.

records.title: Erebor founded
records.description: Thráin I comes to the Lonely Mountain, founds the Kingdom under the Mountain and finds the Arkenstone.

records.title: Minas Ithil becomes Minas Morgul
records.description: After a two-year siege the Nazgûl take Minas Ithil and its palantír; it becomes the Tower of Sorcery, and Minas Anor is renamed Minas Tirith.

records.title: Eärnur rides to Minas Morgul; the Stewards rule
records.description: Answering the Witch-king's challenge, King Eärnur rides alone to the gate of Minas Morgul and is never seen again. Mardil becomes the first Ruling Steward.

records.title: The Watchful Peace begins
records.description: Gandalf goes to Dol Guldur; Sauron retreats into the East and hides for four centuries.

records.title: Thorin I removes to the Grey Mountains
records.description: Thorin I leaves Erebor and goes north to the Grey Mountains, where most of Durin's folk are gathering.

records.title: Buckland settled
records.description: The Oldbucks cross the Brandywine and settle Buckland; Isumbras I becomes the first Took Thain.

records.title: Sauron returns to Dol Guldur
records.description: The Watchful Peace ends; Sauron returns with increased strength. The White Council is formed in 2463.

records.title: Déagol finds the Ring
records.description: Fishing in Anduin, the Stoor Déagol finds the One Ring; Sméagol murders him for it and is driven out.

records.title: Sméagol hides in the Misty Mountains
records.description: Gollum creeps under the mountains and dwells by his lake for nearly five hundred years.

records.title: Osgiliath finally ruined
records.description: The Uruks of Mordor first appear; Osgiliath is finally deserted and its great stone bridge broken.

records.title: Celebrían waylaid in the Redhorn Pass
records.description: Elrond's wife is captured and tormented by Orcs; though rescued, she leaves Middle-earth the next year.

records.title: Battle of the Field of Celebrant
records.description: Eorl the Young and the Éothéod ride to Gondor's aid and destroy the Balchoth and Orcs on the Field of Celebrant.

records.title: Oath of Eorl
records.description: Cirion the Steward gives Calenardhon to Eorl at the tomb of Elendil on the Halifirien; the Riddermark of Rohan is founded.

records.title: Eorl falls in the Wold
records.description: Eorl the Young is slain fighting Easterlings in the Wold; his son Brego completes Meduseld in 2569.

records.title: Baldor enters the Paths of the Dead
records.description: At the feast for Meduseld, Baldor son of Brego vows to tread the Paths of the Dead; he never returns.

records.title: Dáin I slain by a cold-drake
records.description: Dragons multiply in the Grey Mountains; Dáin I and his son Frór are killed at the doors of their hall. Thrór returns to Erebor in 2590.

records.title: Great Smials begun
records.description: Isengrim II begins excavating the Great Smials, the ancestral home of the Tooks.

records.title: Battle of Greenfields
records.description: Bandobras 'Bullroarer' Took routs an Orc-band under Golfimbul in the Northfarthing, the only battle fought in the Shire before 3019.

records.title: Wulf seizes Edoras
records.description: Rohan is invaded from west and east; the Dunlending Wulf takes Meduseld while Helm Hammerhand holds out in the Hornburg.

records.title: The Long Winter
records.description: Five months of snow bring famine to Rohan and Eriador; Helm dies in the snow and Fréaláf drives out Wulf in 2759. Gandalf aids the starving Shire.

records.title: Saruman takes up his abode in Isengard
records.description: Steward Beren gives Saruman the keys of Orthanc; the Wizard settles in Isengard as a warden for Gondor.

records.title: Smaug descends upon Erebor
records.description: The dragon Smaug destroys Dale and drives the Dwarves from the Lonely Mountain; Thrór escapes with Thráin II and Thorin II.

records.title: Thrór slain by Azog
records.description: Thrór is murdered and mutilated by the Orc Azog at the gate of Moria; the Dwarves muster for the War of the Dwarves and Orcs (2793–2799).

records.title: Battle of Azanulbizar
records.description: The Dwarves win a bitter victory before the East-gate of Moria; Azog is slain by Dáin Ironfoot, but Moria remains shut.

records.title: Thráin II settles in the Blue Mountains
records.description: Thráin II and Thorin wander westward and establish halls in the southern Ered Luin beyond the Shire.

records.title: Thráin II imprisoned in Dol Guldur
records.description: Seeking Erebor, Thráin is captured by Sauron's servants and the last of the Seven Rings is taken from him.

records.title: Gandalf enters Dol Guldur
records.description: Gandalf discovers that the Necromancer is indeed Sauron; he finds the dying Thráin and receives the map and key of Erebor.

records.title: Battle of the Crossings of Poros
records.description: The Haradrim cross the Poros; Túrin II of Gondor, aided by Rohan, defeats them, though Folcwine's twin sons fall.

records.title: Bilbo Baggins born
records.description: Bilbo, son of Bungo Baggins and Belladonna Took, is born at Bag End.

records.title: Henneth Annûn built
records.description: Most of Ithilien's remaining people flee the Uruks of Mordor; the Rangers of Ithilien make the hidden refuge of Henneth Annûn.

records.title: The Fell Winter
records.description: The Baranduin freezes; White Wolves invade Eriador and the Shire. Floods the next year ruin Tharbad.

records.title: Tharbad ruined
records.description: Great floods devastate Enedwaith and Minhiriath; Tharbad is ruined and deserted.

records.title: Arador slain by Trolls
records.description: Arador, Chieftain of the Dúnedain, is taken by hill-trolls in the Coldfells; Arathorn II becomes Chieftain.

records.title: Aragorn born
records.description: Aragorn son of Arathorn is born; after his father's death in 2933 he is raised in Rivendell as 'Estel'.

records.title: Bilbo leaves Bag End
records.description: The Quest of Erebor begins: Bilbo runs to the Green Dragon at Bywater to join Thorin and Company.

records.title: Bilbo finds the One Ring
records.description: Lost in the goblin-tunnels, Bilbo finds the Ring and wins the riddle-game with Gollum.

records.title: The White Council attacks Dol Guldur
records.description: Saruman at last agrees to an attack; Sauron, having prepared his plans, abandons Dol Guldur.

records.title: Durin's Day: the secret door opens
records.description: The thrush knocks and the last light of Durin's Day reveals the keyhole; Bilbo enters the Mountain and wakes Smaug.

records.title: Death of Smaug
records.description: Smaug burns Lake-town and is slain by Bard the Bowman with the Black Arrow.

records.title: Battle of Five Armies
records.description: Elves, Men and Dwarves, with the Eagles and Beorn, defeat the Goblins and Wargs of the Misty Mountains in the last week of autumn; Thorin dies and Dáin becomes King under the Mountain.

records.title: Sauron returns to Mordor
records.description: Sauron returns in secret to Mordor; in 2951 he declares himself openly and begins rebuilding Barad-dûr.

records.title: Bilbo returns to Bag End
records.description: Bilbo comes home with the Ring and his share of the troll-hoard, to find his goods being auctioned.

records.title: Dale rebuilt
records.description: Bard rebuilds Dale and becomes its King; Gollum leaves the mountains to hunt the thief of his Precious.

records.title: Nazgûl reoccupy Dol Guldur
records.description: Sauron sends three of the Nazgûl to hold Dol Guldur; Elrond reveals to Aragorn his lineage and Aragorn goes into the Wild.

records.title: Saruman takes Isengard for his own
records.description: After the last meeting of the White Council, Saruman withdraws to Isengard, fortifies it and sets spies in Bree and the Southfarthing.

records.title: Mount Doom bursts into flame
records.description: Orodruin erupts again; the last inhabitants of Ithilien flee over Anduin.

records.title: Thorongil's raid on Umbar
records.description: Aragorn, serving Ecthelion II as 'Thorongil', leads a fleet to Umbar and burns the Corsairs' ships, slaying their Captain.

records.title: Aragorn and Arwen plight their troth
records.description: On the hill of Cerin Amroth Aragorn and Arwen pledge themselves to one another. In the same year Théoden becomes King of Rohan.

records.title: Balin's expedition to Moria
records.description: Balin leaves Erebor with Ori, Óin and many Dwarves to recolonise Moria. He is slain in Dimrill Dale in 2994 and the colony destroyed.

records.title: Bilbo's Farewell Party
records.description: Bilbo's eleventy-first birthday: he vanishes with the Ring, leaves it to Frodo and departs for Rivendell. Gandalf's suspicions grow.

records.title: Gollum captured in the Dead Marshes
records.description: Released from Mordor, Gollum is taken by Aragorn in the Dead Marshes and brought to Thranduil in Mirkwood. Gandalf reads Isildur's scroll in Minas Tirith.

records.title: Gandalf reveals the Ring's nature
records.description: Gandalf reaches Hobbiton and tells Frodo the history of the One Ring; Frodo resolves to leave the Shire.

records.title: Sauron attacks Osgiliath
records.description: The War of the Ring opens: Sauron assails Osgiliath; Boromir and Faramir hold the western shore. About the same time Thranduil is attacked and Gollum escapes.

records.title: Gandalf imprisoned in Orthanc
records.description: Saruman reveals his treachery and holds Gandalf on the pinnacle of Orthanc until Gwaihir bears him away on 18 Sep.

records.title: The Black Riders at Sarn Ford
records.description: The Nazgûl drive off the Rangers guarding Sarn Ford and enter the Shire the next day.

records.title: Frodo leaves Bag End
records.description: Frodo, Sam and Pippin set out on foot as a Black Rider comes to Hobbiton at nightfall.

records.title: The Old Forest
records.description: The hobbits are trapped by Old Man Willow and rescued by Tom Bombadil; on 28 Sep they are captured by a Barrow-wight.

records.title: The Prancing Pony
records.description: Frodo vanishes at the inn and meets Strider; the inn and Crickhollow are raided by the Nazgûl in the early hours of 30 Sep.

records.title: Attack on Weathertop
records.description: Five Nazgûl attack the camp beneath Amon Sûl; the Witch-king stabs Frodo with a Morgul-knife.

records.title: Flight to the Ford of Bruinen
records.description: Glorfindel's horse bears Frodo over the Ford; Elrond's flood sweeps the Nine Riders away.

records.title: Council of Elrond
records.description: The Council resolves that the Ring must be destroyed in Mount Doom; Frodo takes the burden.

records.title: The Fellowship departs
records.description: The Company of the Ring leaves Rivendell at dusk, heading south.

records.title: Defeat on Caradhras
records.description: Snow and stones drive the Fellowship back from the Redhorn Pass.

records.title: The passage of Moria
records.description: The Fellowship enters the West-gate on 13 Jan, finds Balin's tomb, and on 15 Jan Gandalf falls with the Balrog from the Bridge.

records.title: The Fellowship in Lothlórien
records.description: Received by Celeborn and Galadriel; the Mirror of Galadriel on 14 Feb; departure by boat on 16 Feb.

records.title: Gandalf casts down the Balrog
records.description: After the Endless Stair, Gandalf slays the Balrog on the peak of Zirakzigil and passes away, to be sent back as Gandalf the White.

records.title: First Battle of the Fords of Isen
records.description: Saruman's forces attack the Fords; Théodred, the King's son, is slain.

records.title: Breaking of the Fellowship
records.description: Boromir falls defending Merry and Pippin, who are taken by the Uruk-hai; Frodo and Sam go east alone; the Three Hunters pursue the orcs.

records.title: Éomer destroys the Uruk-hai at Fangorn
records.description: The Rohirrim wipe out Uglúk's orc-band at sunrise; Merry and Pippin escape into the forest and meet Treebeard.

records.title: Second Battle of the Fords of Isen
records.description: Erkenbrand's Westfold forces are defeated; the same day Gandalf heals Théoden at Edoras and the Ents march on Isengard.

records.title: Destruction of Isengard
records.description: The Ents break the walls of Isengard and flood the ring; Saruman is trapped in Orthanc.

records.title: Battle of the Hornburg
records.description: Saruman's host assails Helm's Deep through the night; at dawn Théoden rides out and the Huorns destroy the fleeing orcs.

records.title: The Voice of Saruman; Pippin and the palantír
records.description: Gandalf breaks Saruman's staff; that night at Dol Baran Pippin looks into the palantír and Gandalf rides for Minas Tirith.

records.title: Frodo at Henneth Annûn
records.description: Faramir takes Frodo and Sam to the Window of the Sunset, and lets them go on 8 Mar.

records.title: The Paths of the Dead
records.description: Aragorn passes the Dark Door at daybreak and at midnight summons the Dead at the Stone of Erech.

records.title: Gandalf reaches Minas Tirith
records.description: Gandalf and Pippin arrive at dawn; Darkness begins to flow out of Mordor. The Dawnless Day is 10 Mar.

records.title: Muster of Rohan
records.description: The Rohirrim ride from Harrowdale; Merry rides hidden with 'Dernhelm'. Cair Andros falls to an army from the Morannon.

records.title: First assault on Lórien
records.description: Forces of Dol Guldur attack Lórien; further assaults follow on 15 and 22 Mar, all repelled by the power of Galadriel. Eastern Rohan is invaded.

records.title: The Ents defeat the invaders of Rohan
records.description: Ents and Huorns destroy the orcs of Dol Guldur who had invaded eastern Rohan from the north.

records.title: Shelob's Lair
records.description: Gollum leads Frodo into Torech Ungol; Frodo is stung and Sam takes the Ring. Frodo is captured by the orcs of Cirith Ungol on 13 Mar.

records.title: Aragorn captures the fleet at Pelargir
records.description: The Grey Company and the Dead seize the ships of the Corsairs of Umbar; the Dead are released.

records.title: The Pelennor overrun
records.description: Faramir is wounded on the retreat from the Causeway Forts; the siege of Minas Tirith begins on 14 Mar.

records.title: Sam rescues Frodo from the Tower
records.description: Sam finds Frodo in the topmost chamber and they escape into Mordor on 15 Mar.

records.title: Battle of the Pelennor Fields
records.description: The Witch-king breaks the Gate; the Rohirrim arrive at cockcrow. Théoden falls; Éowyn and Merry slay the Witch-king; Aragorn comes up Anduin and the field is won.

records.title: Battle under the Trees
records.description: Thranduil repels the forces of Dol Guldur in northern Mirkwood; much of the forest burns.

records.title: Battle of Dale
records.description: Easterlings storm Dale; King Brand and Dáin Ironfoot fall, and Men and Dwarves are besieged in Erebor.

records.title: The Host of the West marches
records.description: Aragorn leads 7,000 men from Minas Tirith towards the Black Gate; Frodo is overtaken by orcs on the Durthang road.

records.title: Battle of the Morannon
records.description: The Host is surrounded on the Slag-hills; the Mouth of Sauron parleys; the Eagles come.

records.title: The Ring is destroyed
records.description: Gollum bites the Ring from Frodo's hand and falls into the Cracks of Doom; Barad-dûr collapses and Sauron passes away. In Gondor this becomes the first day of the New Year.

records.title: Siege of Erebor broken
records.description: Bard II and Thorin III Stonehelm sally out and drive the Easterlings from Dale.

records.title: Dol Guldur destroyed
records.description: Celeborn crosses Anduin and takes Dol Guldur; Galadriel throws down its walls and lays bare its pits.

records.title: Meeting of Celeborn and Thranduil
records.description: The two Elven-lords meet in the forest and rename it Eryn Lasgalen, the Wood of Greenleaves, dividing it between them and the Beornings.

records.title: Field of Cormallen
records.description: Frodo and Sam are honoured by the Host of the West in Ithilien; 'Praise them with great praise!'

records.title: Crowning of King Elessar
records.description: Aragorn is crowned before the Gate of Minas Tirith, the crown set on his head by Gandalf. Elrond and Arwen set out from Rivendell.

records.title: Wedding of Aragorn and Arwen
records.description: Arwen comes to the City and weds King Elessar; Aragorn has found the sapling of the White Tree on Mindolluin on 25 Jun.

records.title: Funeral of Théoden
records.description: Théoden is laid in the ninth mound at Edoras; Éomer betroths Éowyn to Faramir.

records.title: Saruman met in Dunland
records.description: The travellers overtake Saruman and Wormtongue on the road; Saruman turns towards the Shire.

records.title: Battle of Bywater
records.description: The hobbits rout Sharkey's ruffians; Saruman is slain by Wormtongue at Bag End. Last battle of the War of the Ring.

records.title: The mallorn flowers in the Party Field
records.description: The mallorn planted by Sam from Galadriel's gift blossoms; 1420 becomes the Shire's year of marvellous plenty. Sam weds Rose Cotton on 1 May.

records.title: The Last Riding of the Keepers of the Rings
records.description: Frodo and Sam meet Elrond, Galadriel and Bilbo in the Woody End on the way to the Sea.

records.title: Departure from the Grey Havens
records.description: Frodo, Bilbo, Gandalf, Elrond and Galadriel sail into the West on Círdan's ship. End of the Third Age.

records.title: The Fourth Age begins
records.description: In Gondor the Fourth Age is reckoned from 25 Mar T.A. 3021; the Dominion of Men begins under King Elessar.

records.title: Elessar's edict: the Shire a Free Land
records.description: The King forbids Men to enter the Shire, making it a Free Land under his protection; Sam is elected Mayor. The Drúadan Forest is likewise given to the Woses.

records.title: King Elessar comes north to Annúminas
records.description: Aragorn dwells for a while by Lake Evendim in the restored city of Annúminas and meets his friends at the Brandywine Bridge; Sam receives the Star of the Dúnedain.

records.title: The Westmarch added to the Shire
records.description: The King grants the lands from the Far Downs to the Tower Hills to the Shire; Elanor and Fastred settle at Undertowers.

records.title: Sam passes over the Sea
records.description: After Rose's death Sam gives the Red Book to Elanor at the Tower Hills and, last of the Ring-bearers, sails from the Grey Havens.

records.title: Merry and Pippin ride to Rohan and Gondor
records.description: The two old hobbits leave the Shire, see King Éomer before his death, and die in Gondor, laid to rest in Rath Dínen.

records.title: Death of Faramir
records.description: Faramir, Prince of Ithilien and Steward of Gondor, dies; Elboron succeeds him in Ithilien.

records.title: Death of King Elessar
records.description: Aragorn lays down his life in the House of the Kings; Eldarion succeeds him. Arwen dies on Cerin Amroth the following year.

records.title: Legolas and Gimli sail into the West
records.description: Legolas builds a grey ship in Ithilien and sails down Anduin and over Sea, taking Gimli the Dwarf with him.

records.title: Death of Arwen
records.description: Arwen Undómiel goes alone to fading Lórien and lays herself to rest on Cerin Amroth.

records.title: Durin VII retakes Khazad-dûm
records.description: Durin the Last eventually leads Durin's folk back to Khazad-dûm. No year is recorded. A date after Fo.A. 171 is an inference from the Red Book's copying date, not an explicit date in Tolkien's chronology.
